mapper.select: select count(*) as review_count,round(avg(rating), 1) as average_rating from tbl_review where expert_seq = #{expertSeq}
select r.*,m.name as customer_name from tbl_review r inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = r.customer_seq where r.expert_Seq = #{expertSeq} order by r.regdate desc fetch first 5 rows only
